truth_use: Offline evaluation only; no class remapping, identity correction or target position supplied to the detector or controller.
original_trial_decision: Keep YOLOX; the evaluated aerial model misclassified the known evaluation car as bus and was not integrated.
decision: Retain YOLOX primary; add the pinned aerial detector at <=0.5 Hz globally for generic vehicle discovery. Keep raw subclasses provisional and operator-visible. Correct the visual car model and compensate camera motion for selected CSRT continuity.

textured_car_flight.limit: This single-car trial does not validate reliable car/truck/bus subclass recognition throughout the city.
